caveat: Desktop headless-chromium probe results. On-device behavior can differ (anti-bot/fingerprinting), so NEVER prune a provider on desktop DEAD alone — confirm via logcat (FILMKU_AUTOCAPTURE trace) before removing. Re-run: TMDB_API_KEY=xxx ./tool/probe_providers.sh (the key is read from the environment, never hardcoded).

vidlink.label: VidLink
vidlink.notes: The only source currently confirmed producing a playable NATIVE stream (signed .mp4 exposed after JS/WASM decrypt). Relies on headless/intercept extraction.

two_embed_skin.label: 2Embed.skin
two_embed_skin.notes: Native playback for BOTH chains since v1.3.24: legacy swish -> 2vcdn.skin direct extraction + PNG-strip relay (v1.3.11), and the rotated vnest chain -> VidNest server API (new.vidnest.fun) whose custom-base64 payload decodes to CDN streams with the exact Referer mpv needs (goodstream.cc: 403 without, 200 with). Re-verified live 2026-08-06 (Spider-Man: No Way Home).

two_embed.label: 2Embed.cc
two_embed.notes: Legacy domain; serves about:blank in some regions (white screen — the WebView auto-failovers). Works via WebView in regions where it renders.

vidsrc_to.label: VidSrc.to
vidsrc_to.notes: Redirects through vsembed.ru; CDN refused on the user's ISP (ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED on tokenized hosts). Kept as a toggle — verify on-device before pruning.

vidsrc_su.label: VidSrc.su
vidsrc_su.notes: Serves an empty shell page. Kept as a toggle — verify on-device before pruning.
